edges.reason: tx.origin is used as the key for _holderLastTransferTimestamp to enforce one purchase per block, making the anti-bot delay spoofable by intermediate contracts
_transfer reads tx.origin directly for the transfer delay check, creating tx.origin authorization dependency
_holderFirstBuyTimestamp is written with block.timestamp, so early-sell tax depends on miner-controllable time
block.timestamp arithmetic drives the 24 hour early sell window inside _transfer
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline to the router, making the swap dependent on block time
_transfer invokes swapBack while the swapping flag is toggled, and token balances are settled before external calls complete
swapBack performs a low-level ETH call to devWallet with state (tokensFor*) zeroed before the second external call
swapBack sweeps the entire contract balance to marketingWallet via low-level call without a reentrancy guard on the function itself
swapBack calls the private helper swapTokensForEth
swapBack calls the private helper addLiquidity when liquidity tokens are available
swapTokensForEth triggers the external router swap for fee-on-transfer tokens
addLiquidity forwards ETH to the router addLiquidityETH call
amount.mul(fees).div(100) and the final amount -= fees rely on SafeMath but the mutated fee state can shift arithmetic outcomes
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFees to bypass the trading gate and fee taking
_transfer branches on automatedMarketMakerPairs to distinguish buys, sells and wallet transfers
_transfer recomputes sellTotalFees from early sell fee state variables before applying fee math
_transfer enforces maxTransactionAmount on buy and sell paths
_transfer enforces maxWallet on buys and wallet transfers
_transfer requires both from and to not be blacklisted and can add to the blacklist at launch
_transfer compares block.number against launchedAt for the anti-bot sniping blacklist
_transfer sets and clears the swapping guard around the swapBack external interaction
Chire grants full self-allowance before looping transferFrom, an owner-only privileged allowance escalation
Chire passes msg.sender as the transferFrom origin for the airdrop loop
transfer() forwards _msgSender() into _transfer as the from address
swapBack reads and resets tokensForLiquidity when computing swap amounts
swapBack reads and resets tokensForDev when computing the dev ETH share
swapBack reads and resets tokensForMarketing when computing the marketing ETH share
swapBack reads devWallet to build the low-level payout call target
swapBack reads marketingWallet to build the final balance sweep call target
enableTrading is onlyOwner and permanently flips tradingActive to true
updateSellFees is onlyOwner and rewrites sellTotalFees and component sell fees
updateMarketingWallet is onlyOwner and redirects the ETH payout destination
from parameter flows into _transfer limit, blacklist and fee branches
to parameter flows into _transfer limit, blacklist and AMM pair checks
amount parameter flows into _transfer max amount checks and fee arithmetic
contractBalance local drives the burn/liquidity split in swapBack
liquidityTokens local determines how many tokens are reserved for addLiquidity
recipients array controls the transferFrom destinations in the Chire loop
values array controls the scaled transfer amounts in the Chire loop
